obligations.note: The new CaseService.reopen moves a WITHDRAWN case to DRAFT and saves it without calling audit.record. Every other state-changing operation in CaseService records an audit event with actor, action, target and time.

The only new log call is log.info("Case " + caseId + " reopened by " + actor.userId()), which carries the case id and user id and no NPI. The registered sample control test LoggingControlTest#sampledFlowsDoNotLogNpi passed.
Ticket CHG-26477 is a standard ticket, approved on 2026-10-22 (before review) by Erik Brandt, a change_manager. Its components [mortgage.cases] cover the only touched file, CaseService.java.
The code_review approval is from wen.li@fernbrook.example, who holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author, Declan Farrell.
The approval names the head commit 8c6c5359, which is the change's only commit.

run.json names the head commit and runner ci-runner-06, but every JUnit report gives hostname dev-laptop-7.local, so the reports may not come from this CI run. The description also claims unit tests were updated, yet no test file changed and no test exercises reopen.
The only touched component is mortgage.cases, which is not security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
No protected paths (controls data, control tests, CI) are touched, so no control_owner approval is required.
No approved, unexpired exception in the register covers AUD-1 for mortgage.cases, so the missing audit event on reopen is an unexcepted deviation.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers CaseService.java; the covered code (Underwriting, Approvals, Policy, payments files) is unchanged.

summary: PR-1202 adds CaseService.reopen, a state-changing operation that moves a withdrawn case back to DRAFT and saves it without writing an audit event. That violates AUD-1, and no exception covers the deviation. The ticket, the independent approval and the approval's coverage of the head commit are in order. The CI evidence is questionable: the JUnit reports' hostname is a personal machine, not the named CI runner, and no tests were added for reopen. The change is rejected; it needs an audit.record call for reopen, tests for it, and a clean CI run.
